Vaguay a facizer
Unsuffus a facizer from on top of another facizer
Redunde a facizer
Suffus a facizer on top of another facizer

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only vaguay or unsuffus one facizer at a time.
I can only vaguay or unsuffus a facizer if my hand is empty.
I can only vaguay a facizer if the facizer is on the table and the facizer is clear. A facizer is clear if the facizer has no other facizers on top of it and if the facizer is not vaguayed.
I can only unsuffus a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unsuffussing was really on top of the other facizer.
I can only unsuffus a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unsuffussing is clear.
Once I vaguay or unsuffus a facizer, I am holding the facizer.
I can only redunde a facizer that I am holding.
I can only suffus a facizer on top of another facizer if I am holding the facizer being suffussed.
I can only suffus a facizer on top of another facizer if the facizer onto which I am suffussing the facizer is clear.
Once I redunde or suffus a facizer, my hand becomes empty.
Once you suffus a facizer on top of a second facizer, the second facizer is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the michime facizer is clear, the tegust facizer is clear, the hand is empty, the michime facizer is on top of the wilchip facizer, the tegust facizer is on top of the westoor facizer, the westoor facizer is on the table and the wilchip facizer is on the table.
My goal is to have that the michime facizer is on top of the westoor facizer, the tegust facizer is on top of the michime facizer and the westoor facizer is on top of the wilchip facizer.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

(suffus b2 b1)
